title: ESP-NOW: Sending from the T-Display v1.1
description: In this example the LilyGO/TTGO T-Display v1.1 sends a counter to another ESP32 over ESP-NOW and shows the link on its 1.14 inch LCD: messages sent, delivery rate and a strip of the last 38 messages. The buttons pause sending and change the rate.
author: Steven Slaa
